text:
ivy: Massive panicleft my laptop in an Uber after the keynote. just realized at the gate. 
marc: Oh no! Did you try "Find My" or Google Find My Device?
ivy: Yep logged into iCloud from my phone. shows offline but last seen near the venue, about 10:12.
bea: If it's offline, try the "Mark as lost" / lock option so it requires your password to unlock.
jules: Also contact the driver via the appthere's usually a button to call the driver or request item return.
it-help: Hi Ivy  please do the following ASAP: 1) Mark device as lost/lock it 2) Change your Redwood password and sign out of sessions 3) Enable remote wipe if needed. We can help restore a loaner.
ivy: On it. Locked and put a message on the screen with a phone number. thanks IT.
marc: If you use FileVault/BitLocker you're probably fine, but rotate any API keys that were on the laptop just in case.
bea: Also check the ride receipt in your email for the trip ID and timestamp  useful when contacting transit support.
transit-bot: Tip: Use the "Report lost item" in Uber/Lyft app within 24 hours. The app will attempt to call the driver and schedule a meetup.
ivy: Driver responded! He said he found it and will drop at venue lost & found in ~30min. :relieved:
jules: Praise the driver  but still follow IT steps so you're covered.
it-help: Confirmed. Once you have the device back, don't log in until we scan and patch. If it's not returned within 2 hours, we will trigger a remote wipe and issue a loaner.
offsite-bot: Reminder: If you buy a replacement or need expedited shipping for a loaner, keep receipts and tag expense as "emergency travel equipment".
ivy: Got it. Driver just handed it to venue staff and I picked it up. Everything looks fine. IT still wants to re-image as a precaution.
it-help: Thanks for confirming. Please drop the laptop at IT desk on floor 3 when you get back and well reprovision. We'll open a small ticket to track.
marc: Glorious ending. Maybe we should add a tiny "lost device" item to offsite checklist.
bea: Agreed  emergency contact + quick lock steps.
jules: Tiny PSA: put an emergency contact on your lock screen (job title + phone)  it helped here.
